title: Tunnel Log

examples.explanation: The count inside goes 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 0, never below zero, and ends at zero.
After the third event, more people have left than entered.

constraints: log contains only the characters E and X

approaches.name: single pass with a running count

steps.title: Clarify the input
steps.description: Confirms the two conditions: nobody can leave an empty tunnel, and the tunnel must be empty at the end. Asks about an empty log.
look_for: asks whether the tunnel must be empty at the end
mentions an exit before any entry
hints: Before you start, is there anything about what makes a log valid that you'd want to confirm?
Is it enough for entries and exits to balance out by the end?
There are two rules: never below zero at any point, and exactly zero at the end.

steps.title: Keep a running count
steps.description: Tracks how many people are inside, adding one for E and subtracting one for X.
hints: Look at what you need to know at each moment of the log.
Can you tell if the log is valid by tracking a single number?
Keep a running count of people inside the tunnel.

steps.title: Catch an exit from an empty tunnel
steps.description: Fails as soon as the count drops below zero, even if it balances later.
look_for: checks for a negative count inside the loop
hints: Try your code on a log that balances at the end but goes wrong in the middle.
Does your code notice the moment more people have left than entered?
Check inside the loop whether the count has gone below zero.

steps.title: Check the end
steps.description: Requires the count to be exactly zero after the last event.
look_for: tests a log with people left inside
hints: Try your code on a log that only has entries.
What should the answer be if people are still inside when the log ends?
After the loop, the log is only valid if the count is back to zero.

edge_cases.description: the log starts with an exit
people still inside at the end
it goes negative in the middle but ends balanced

common_mistakes.description: only compares the total number of E and X
common_mistakes.symptom: accepts 'EXXE', where someone leaves an empty tunnel

common_mistakes.description: checks for negatives but not the final count

wrap_up_questions: What are the time and space complexity?
How would you report the position of the first bad event instead of just True or False?

origin_note: Original. Pattern: single pass with a running count.
